title: JBMC's extra initializers named and refused: the conformance corpus under JBMC, auto and --confirm, and the draft report's example (closes VF-009 when step 2 passes)
description:
Resubmitted unchanged by the cleanup-jbmc stream at VF-009's fix: it closes VF-009 (verification/findings.md) when step 2, the corpus under auto --confirm, passes. The fix: JBMC 6.11.0 gives a class initializer's exception to its caller unwrapped (job 20261107-163056), and the preflight now names it as the JBMC defect throwing-initializer, so JBMC's refutations of boomTwice and enumBroken at n=0 are no verdict under --confirm and the own checker's proofs stand. The steps are the original job's.

Item 2 of the engine-priorities brief's Progress (llm-dlc/loops/engine-priorities.md). Job 20261106-203501 found a false proof of JBMC under --gaps strict: conformance/declaring/2 (result == n + 107) was Verified by JBMC, while the JVM returns n + 7. Reading JBMC 6.11.0's --show-goto-functions (inline, nothing solved) showed two ways it runs class initializers the JVM does not (JVMS 5.5): at a getstatic, putstatic or invokestatic it initializes the class the instruction names, not the class that declares the resolved member (Sub.value, declared by Holder, runs Sub.<clinit>); and a class's <clinit_wrapper> initializes every superinterface, where the JVM initializes only those that declare a default method (conformance/defaults: JBMC computes 43, the JVM 3, which is why JBMC's counterexample to defaults/1 did not reproduce). The preflight (lib/src/jbmc_gaps.rs) now names each such instruction as the defect extra-initializer, by comparing the wrappers JBMC's goto program calls there with bmc::gaps::initializers of the declaring class, and refuses a JBMC proof through one under every --gaps mode, as for the three defects before. The corpus gains defaults/3 (result == 43), the second shape's false proof. The goto parser also keeps a location across JBMC's '// Labels:' comments, which it had dropped. Unit-tested on hand-written goto programs of tests/fixtures/jbmc-defects/p/D.java, and checked inline on JBMC's real listings of the fixture and of conformance.Conformance (declaring and defaults named; superFirst, cycle, boomTwice, direct reads and new not). The last step runs the draft upstream report's example (tests/fixtures/jbmc-defects/I.java) on the JVM and through JBMC, so the report's claim that JBMC fails both assertions is measured rather than read from the listing.
expected: Steps 1 and 2 exit 0. In step 1, declaring/2 and defaults/3 under Jbmc/Strict are Unverifiable, the proof refused naming extra-initializer, and Violation under Auto/Strict; no claim the JVM refutes is Verified. Step 3 prints 'log 3' from the JVM and VERIFICATION FAILED from JBMC for both I.field and I.iface. Any other disagreement is a finding to triage.

steps.name: conformance corpus under JBMC and auto
steps.run: set -o pipefail; cd lib && mkdir -p target && JVMCONTRACT_JBMC_MEMORY_MB=2048 cargo test --release --test conformance the_corpus_agrees_with_the_jvm_under_jbmc_and_auto -- --ignored --nocapture 2>&1 | tee target/conformance-jbmc-initializers.log

steps.name: conformance corpus under auto --confirm
steps.run: set -o pipefail; cd lib && mkdir -p target && JVMCONTRACT_JBMC_MEMORY_MB=2048 cargo test --release --test conformance the_corpus_agrees_with_the_jvm_under_auto_confirm -- --ignored --nocapture 2>&1 | tee target/conformance-confirm-initializers.log

steps.name: the draft report's example on the JVM and JBMC
steps.run: set -o pipefail; mkdir -p lib/target/report-i && javac -g -d lib/target/report-i lib/tests/fixtures/jbmc-defects/I.java && (java -ea -cp lib/target/report-i I; for f in field iface; do echo "== jbmc I --function I.$f"; jbmc I --function I.$f --classpath lib/target/report-i; echo "exit $?"; done) 2>&1 | tee lib/target/report-i.log; grep -q '^log 3' lib/target/report-i.log && test "$(grep -c '^VERIFICATION FAILED' lib/target/report-i.log)" -eq 2
